448354.overview:
This game is based on Popcap's Plants vs. Zombies series. The player sides with the plants defending the garden against invading zombies. The game retains the concept of waves from tower defense games. By defeating zombies in various missions coins are earned that can be spent at Dave's Twiddy Dinkies for items that boost the score or provide bonuses.

The table has two regular flippers at the bottom, one at the top left, and one at the top right at a higher area. Access to the outlanes at the end of a ramp happens through a pool and a mailbox. A sunflower can be waken up to gather sun icons as a resource spent on various seed packets found through a flower pot on the left. The top right flipper is the only access to the Melon-Putt that can rain down melons on zombies. These zombies appear as 3D animated characters on the table. There is also a car that can be hit to open its trunk and lock the ball inside. After three locked balls multiball is activated. When all four main missions are completed, Dr. Zomboss at the back of the table is woken up. He spits huge balls of snow or fire defeating by selecting the appropriate ball through the flower pot.

460472.overview: Zarza is famously a clone of Bally's 1980 hit Xenon. While it shares a nearly identical playfield layout and aesthetic—including the tube-like ramps and futuristic sci-fi theme—it features different sound effects and unique Taito branding.

460496.overview: Zephy is a rare solid-state pinball machine released in 1982 by the Brazilian manufacturer LTD do Brasil Diversões Eletrônicas Ltda. The game is notable for being based on the popular Bally table, Xenon.

469139.overview:
Zombie Invasion! The mode where brain fluid polishes the steel ball! 

You must survive through endless waves of zombie hordes on a uniquely designed pinball table. Upgrade your soldiers and unleash powerful attacks like fireball, freeze, thunderstrike, tornado and gas to defend yourself against the Zombie Invasion and stay alive as long as you can. Good luck soldier!

A Magic Pixel original, released as DLC for their Zaccaria Pinball collection, the table is an entertaining mix of pinball action and tower defense, and has similarities to the iOS game Zombie Rollerz: Pinball Heroes. It's an enjoyable twist on regular pinball, though the downside is that the difficulty ramps up very slowly so it can take a long time before the gameplay becomes challenging.

469424.overview:
Enter the untamed world of Zankor! Face wild beasts, ancient traps, and overgrown ruins in this primal jungle-powered pinball adventure.

Released in 1986 by the Italian manufacturer Zaccaria, Zankor is a fantasy-themed pinball table from the company's "Generation 2" era. With only approximately 60 units produced, it is considered a rare and complex entry in the Zaccaria library. 

It features an upper playfield without its own flippers, requiring precise shots from the main level to access, and is noted for its constant, synthesized background music and unique voice synthesis that attempts to say "Zankor" (though it often sounds clipped).

470440.overview:
The jungle awakens! Lush foliage, will creatures, and thrilling challenges bring this Zankor adventure back to life.

Zankor 2017 is an enhanced digital remake by Magic Pixel of the 1986 solid-state Zaccaria table, released as DLC in 2017 for Zaccaria Pinball on all major platforms.

471099.overview:
The Legend of Zelda is a homebrew digital pinball table that was created by LoadedWeapon in 2009 for Future Pinball, and years later ported over to Visual Pinball by JP Salas. 

The table itself is a re-theme of Roney Pinball's original Future Pinball table, "Medieval Castle".

471943.overview:
The jungle comes alive!  Giant spiders lurk among lush greenery in this intense and immersive wild adventure.

This enhanced edition of Zaccaria's 1986 table brings an adventurous jungle theme to life through striking visuals and dynamic gameplay. Players are challenged on a journey through four distinct modes: Make Camp, Craft Weapon, Explore the Jungle and Defeat the Spider. 

Zankor Deluxe builds upon the original design with refined mechanics and new features, delivering a fast-paced, immersive pinball experience. Every shot propels players deeper into the untamed wilderness, where skill and strategy determine survival.

479612.overview:
Zombies Ate My Neighbors is a 1993 run and gun Super Nintendo Entertainment System and Sega Genesis video game.

This pinball version was released for Future Pinball in 2015 by ghostmachine, and received a graphical update by Lbyms in 2024.

480038.overview:
Jipar's Zombieland table for Future Pinball is based on the 2009 horror comedy movie, and features Metallica's "For Whom The Bell Tolls" and Van Halen's "Everybody Wants Some" from the movie's OST.

Two months have passed since a strain of mad cow disease mutated into "mad person disease" that became "mad zombie disease", which overran the entire United States, turning many Americans into vicious zombies. Players must hit zombie targets and complete missions to win extra balls and get a high score.
